# box-tension: a study for the window's tests

box-setup's tension (tests/fixtures/calculix/box-setup) as a study folder:
the box meshed at size 5, quadratic, which gives box-setup's mesh, so the
stand-in ccx (tests/fixtures/fake-ccx), replaying ccx 2.23's own files for
box-setup, fits it. The walkthrough copies this folder before running, so
the runs it makes (steps/solve/runs/<n>) never land here.
